target_context.trillionnium/Cargo.toml:
[workspace]
resolver = "2"
members = [
  "crates/trnm-audit-events",
  "crates/trnm-governance-guard",
  "crates/trnm-escrow-vault",
  "crates/trnm-types",
  "crates/trnm-executor",
  "crates/trnm-bench",
  "crates/trnm-mempool",
  "crates/trnm-worker-agent",
  "crates/trnm-oracle",
  "crates/trnm-research-protocol",
  "crates/trnm-protocol",
  "crates/trnm-peer-lease",
  "crates/trnm-data-availability",
  "crates/trnm-task-kernel",
  "crates/trnm-mvcc-fee",
  "crates/trnm-service-settlement",
  "crates/trnm-control-plane",
  "crates/trnm-state-import",
  "crates/trnm-release-bundle",
  "crates/trnm-checkpoint-store",
  "crates/trnm-checkpoint-types",
  "crates/trnm-crypto-primitives",
  "crates/trnm-verification-profiles",
  "crates/trnm-transport",
  "crates/trnm-pon-node",
  "crates/trnm-sqlite-io-boundary",
]

[workspace.package]
edition = "2021"
license = "MIT"
authors = ["Trillionnium Contributors"]

[workspace.metadata.trnm]
lane = "chain-protocol"
development_target = "pon-nakamoto-v1"
implementation_status = "native-development-profiles-not-publicly-qualified"
production_consensus_activation = false

[profile.test.package.curve25519-dalek]
opt-level = 3

[profile.test.package.ed25519-dalek]
opt-level = 3

[profile.test.package.sha2]
opt-level = 3
debug-assertions = true
overflow-checks = true

# Preserve test checks while compiling repeated full-state traversal efficiently.
# These overrides do not change development or release build profiles.
[profile.test.package.trnm-protocol]
opt-level = 3
debug-assertions = true
overflow-checks = true

[profile.test.package.trnm-mvcc-fee]
opt-level = 1
debug-assertions = true
overflow-checks = true

# Keep the full debug/test inventory and all checks, but compile the costly
# public-work primitive with the same optimizing compiler used for native work.
# This is a test-build choice, not a resource-policy or security qualification.
[profile.test.package.trnm-crypto-primitives]
opt-level = 3
debug-assertions = true
overflow-checks = true

# LOCAL DEBUG EXPERIMENT ONLY: do not merge this artifact without independent full CI.
[profile.test.package.trnm-pon-node]
opt-level = 3
debug-assertions = true
overflow-checks = true
target_context.trillionnium/crates/trnm-worker-agent/Ca:
[package]
publish = false
name = "trnm-worker-agent"
version = "0.1.0"
edition.workspace = true
license.workspace = true
authors.workspace = true

[dependencies]
anyhow = "1"
clap = { version = "4", features = ["derive"] }
serde = { version = "1", features = ["derive"] }
serde_json = "1"
sha2 = "0.10"
getrandom = "0.4"
hex = "0.4"
shlex = "1"
shell-escape = "0.1"
trnm-types = { version = "0.1.0", path = "../trnm-types" }
wait-timeout = "0.2"

[target.'cfg(unix)'.dependencies]
rustix = { version = "1.1.6", features = ["fs", "process"] }

[dev-dependencies]
tempfile = "3"
